applicationStart:
cd code_deploy_application && npm ci && npm run build
nohup npx vite preview --port 8080 --host 0.0.0.0 --strictPort >> /root/application.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /root/application.pid
applicationStop: if [ -f /root/application.pid ]; then kill "$(cat /root/application.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /root/application.pid; fi
